title: Doc: README and PRFAQ contradict on wolfHSM backend status
description: README.md lists wolfHSM as a supported backend. PRFAQ.md states 'the wolfHSM backend is planned but not yet implemented in this release.' These are directly contradictory. Additionally, PRFAQ.md Q&A references 'wh_token_db[]' but the actual struct is named 'wp11_token_db[]'. Fix: reconcile wolfHSM status across both documents. Fix the wh_token_db typo in PRFAQ.
